title: Lamb Tagine with Exotic Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb tagine with exotic spices, perfect for a special occasion. This dish is inspired by the rich flavors of the Mediterranean region.
instructions: Season the lamb with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper to the pot.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Add 1 cup of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
